visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED KB-era mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target for this route any more. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, Oregon licenses, transparent-PNG headshots, verbatim Google reviews, and a door to each /team/[slug] profile.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-ABOUT). Rhythm: two of the six patterns (Quiet, Ledger), no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb, Quiet (who you work with, headingLevel 1), Ledger (three brokers from getBrokers, Matt-Rebecca-Paul rank), Quiet (verbatim reviews + FAQ + edges), Footer. No Sheet on the index: the family's Sheets live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Primary ask is /contact. Reviews: getReviews(24) sorted so non-Matt-named reviews surface first (design-audit #156), TESTIMONIALS fallback when the live pool is empty. No invented quotes. KB-era deletions: KbHero, KbAbout, KbTeam, KbTestimonials, KbSell, FAQBlock, SmoothScrollProvider, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css import.

perBrokerPage.note: Per-broker profile on the v3 barrel. Invariants: (1) reviewBelongsOnPage filters every review. (2) getBrokerSales provides per-broker closings (both sides); fallback is getBrokerageListingTiles. (3) JSON-LD RealEstateAgent + BreadcrumbList preserved. (4) 977 zip filter on closings. (5) photo-only ledger tiles. (6) BrokerValuationSheet posts the same submitBrokerSellerLead object (variant seller, fields address / name / email / phone / timeline / notes). (7) SmsConsentDisclosure renders because the sheet collects a phone; the action does not read smsConsent. (8) Direct call/text/email from live phone/email only.
